primitives.name: Praos header and chain verifier
primitives.desc: Decodes Conway and Babbage Praos block headers and verifies them on its own code path: the leader VRF proof against the epoch nonce, the operational certificate, the Sum6 KES body signature, and hash-linked gap-free chain segments across epoch boundaries with nonce evolution. A byte provider can only make a genuine proof fail, never make a forged one pass.

primitives.name: Mithril certificate-chain verifier
primitives.desc: Verifies a Mithril certificate chain anchored at the network genesis key: genesis Ed25519 root, STM stake-threshold multi-signatures, AVK binding across epochs and byte-exact content hashing, plus the cardano-database ancillary manifest. Behind the mithril feature so the default and WebAssembly builds stay lean.

primitives.name: Certified transaction inclusion and UTxO read
primitives.desc: Proves a transaction's inclusion in the Mithril CardanoTransactions set by recomputing the MMR and map proofs. Inclusion is provenance only: a transaction body does not carry its phase-2 outcome, so the read establishes no output from it, and a created output is read from its creating block instead. It never claims an output is unspent.

primitives.name: Windowed-unspent follower
primitives.desc: Tier 1 of the trust ladder: from a certified anchor to a verified tip, re-verifies every block header and binds every block body, and reports whether any input spent a watched outpoint inside that gap-free window. Creation is read under each block's phase-2 record, which also backs a read of one created output from block bytes bound to an expected block hash. An unverifiable stretch is reported as stalled, never as unspent. Also carries the self-verified UTxO-set engine and its per-block effects for the reserved Tier 2.

primitives.name: Sextant C ABI and WebAssembly surface
primitives.desc: The stable cbindgen-generated C header over a cdylib or staticlib, every export inside a panic guard, plus the wasm32 build of the default graph for in-browser and on-device verification. This is how a non-Rust consumer (a keeper, a wallet, a page) calls the verifiers.

primitives.name: Heliograph canonical journal codec
primitives.desc: Canonical no_std journal types and codec for portable Sextant verdicts, with 61 tests and a coverage ledger. Parked as of 2026-10-27; resume for the first consumer needing a Cardano fact verified on a chain that cannot run Sextant natively, such as an EVM state oracle or a bridge to a chain without a Cardano client.

primitives.name: Heliograph portable ZK verdict design and experiments
primitives.desc: Guest/prover design for CLAIMS checkpoint, extension, header-segment, inclusion and UTxO-read claims, plus deferred window/set claims and frozen SP1/RISC Zero Mithril spikes pinned before C-1. Parked as of 2026-10-27; resume for the first consumer needing a Cardano fact verified on a chain that cannot run Sextant natively, such as an EVM state oracle or a bridge to a chain without a Cardano client. Revived guests must use the in-repo Sextant by path.

primitives.name: Windowed-unspent watch daemon
primitives.desc: An HTTP service: POST an outpoint, and it follows the chain from the creating block to the live tip over a node-to-node relay, re-verifies every block through the windowed follower, re-anchors to fresh Mithril certificates, and serves no_spend_observed, spend_observed or stalled as JSON. Wired for preprod only today, and it locates creating transactions through Koios.
